# Port

[Index](../index.md) · [Rules](../rules.md) · [Sources](../sources.md)

Fortified sweet red wine from Portugal. (Only red Ports are modeled, as in the paper.)

- Is a: [DessertWine](c-dessert-wine.md), [RedWine](c-red-wine.md)
